blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said, “Learn the Qur'an and teach it to people as well; learn the knowledge of the Deen and teach it to people as well; learn the laws of inheritance and teach them to people as well. For my soul will be taken. Knowledge of the Deen will become very scarce, and the knowledge of the Deen will soon be raised up. Two people will dispute about a Fard ruling, and there will be no one to give the correct explanation of that ruling.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ الْبَاهِلِيِّ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِﷺ: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ! خُذُوا مِنَ الْعِلْمِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُقْبَضَ الْعِلْمُ وَقَبْلَ أَنْ يُرْفَعَ الْعِلْمُ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Umamah Bahili (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said, “O people! Learn knowledge before Ilm is taken back, before knowledge is seized.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: إِنَّ مِمَّا يَلْحَقُ الْمُؤْمِنَ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ وَحَسَنَاتِهِ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهِ عِلْماً عَلَّمَهُ وَنَشَرَهُ وَوَلَدًا صَالِحاً تَرَكَهُ وَمُصْحَفاً وَرَّثَهُ أَوْ مَسْجِدًا بَنَاهُ أَوْ بَيْتاً لِّابْنِ السَّبِيلِ بَنَاهُ أَوْ نَهْرًا أَجْرَاهُ أَوْ صَدَقَةً أَخْرَجَهَا مِنْ مَالِهِ فِي صِحَّتِهِ وَحَيَاتِهِ يَلْحَقُهُ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَوْتِهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابن ماجه باب ثواب معلم الناس الخير رقم:٢٤٢
blocks.tamil_translation: “First, a person teaching to others the knowledge he learnt and spreading it; second, the righteous children he leaves behind; third, the Qur'an he leaves behind as inheritance; fourth, the masjid he built; fifth, the inn he built for travellers to stay in,
